preconditions: mas_file object has been zero-initialized or constructed before open (sub_55FBE0 zeroes +0xC..+0x130 and writes the magic header)
filename argument to open is a non-empty NUL-terminated string
stream handle passed to the locked file wrappers is open and not flagged closed (bit 0x40 at file_stream+0xC)
strbuf capacity at +0x4 tracks the allocated size of the buffer at +0x0
linked-list/registry head pointers are valid (or 0) before insert/lookup
postconditions: on success mas_file holds an open FILE* at +0x10, a verified magic header at +0x0, and a payload buffer at +0x128 whose size is +0x11C (= (+0x118 << 8) + 24)
on failure open closes any opened handle, leaves +0x10 cleared, reports through the error reporter, and returns a non-zero code
release closes the handle at +0x10 and frees the buffer at +0x128, then clears both to 0
strbuf set/append keep a NUL-terminated string and grow the allocation when the capacity would be exceeded
read-line returns a NUL-terminated line or 0 at EOF with no data read
param-block build links one new node per call and increments the owning list
side_effects: allocates and frees heap memory through the NhMalloc wrappers (sub_587C03 allocate, sub_587BCF free) for nodes, string buffers and the MAS payload
acquires and releases the stream critical section around every locked file operation (read, close, seek)
uppercases or table-decodes the filename in place via sub_589901, which may touch the global lookup table dword_8D3F38 under an interlocked guard
reports file/format errors through the out-of-packet error reporter on open failure paths
recursively modifies flag_state +0x3C bit flags and may re-enter sub_54C030 when +0x44/+0x4C are set
appends/relinks intrusive singly- or doubly-linked nodes and increments list counters
reads (does not write) the global MAS search-path table dword_8B8E30/byte_8B5A3C during open fallback

external_dependencies.name: CriticalSection stream lock and lazy-init helpers

unresolved: mas_file magic header at +0x0 is a 12-byte string (fread of 12, strcmp vs three literals); schema width 4 only reports the leading dword
sub_55FC40 copies filename into the inline buffer at +0x14 (this+20) with an overlapping move; buffer length is unproven
semantics of the +0x114/+0x120 header dwords (and +0x124/+0x12C/+0x130 zeroed dwords) are unknown beyond being header words read from the file
sub_587F64 calls out-of-packet FileTellSeekPositionQuery(a1,a2,a3) with three args; whether it is fseek (offset,origin) or ftell is unresolved
sub_587C20 (strstr-like) contains a JUMPOUT(0x589DB6) out-of-line tail; the two-byte-needle path is not fully represented in the packet
sub_58815F/sub_5887ED wrap out-of-packet format helpers; the 66/73 constants and 0x7FFFFFFF cap semantics (snprintf-style length bound?) are unproven
sub_5651B0 return codes 0..4 are a script/expression line-parser state machine; exact meaning of each code (comment 3, empty 1, block-close 2, ok 0/4) is inferred only from local control flow
sub_551560/sub_551830/sub_5518A0 share an intrusive linked-list + name-string pattern but have distinct owner objects (this[76]/this[79] vs this[70]); a shared class owner is not proven
sub_551560's param lookup walks an external table a2 (+0xC count, +0x10 entries, 44-byte stride) and writes matched values into 136-byte records; record/table producer is outside the packet
sub_54C030 calls itself when this[17]/this[19] are set; the semantic meaning of a2/a3/a4/a5 (toggle/slot/gate?) is unresolved
sub_545930 inserts into either the this-owned list or a sub-list rooted at a3+560 (0x230) when a3 is non-null; the a3 object type is unknown

sub_589901 has two behaviors gated by global dword_8D3F38: an uppercase-in-place path and a table-decode path that replaces the buffer contents; the table's record format and key semantics are unknown
FileCloseWithLock treats flag bit 0x40 at file_stream+0xC as already-closed and skips the close; whether 0x40 means owned/closed/borrowed is unresolved
variadic wrappers sub_58815F/sub_5887ED carry no calling-convention marker in the raw C; cdecl is assumed from the va_list use
EmptyStub_7470 delegates to out-of-packet EmptyStub_0170, so its real body (an empty/stub cleanup) is outside the packet
the euler matrix sub_566E40 is __fastcall per the raw C with two float* args; whether a2 is row-major or column-major is unresolved
tests_required: MAS open success: file handle at +0x10 open, magic verified, +0x11C == (+0x118 << 8) + 24, payload bytes readable at +0x128
MAS open missing file: returns -2, no open handle retained, error reported
MAS open wrong magic: returns -1 and closes the handle
file_stream read-line: returns a NUL-terminated line and stops at newline; returns 0 on EOF with no bytes
FileCloseWithLock: a second close on a stream flagged 0x40 is a no-op
strbuf set/append: NUL-terminated content and capacity growth at the exact-fit boundary
euler matrix: identity matrix for zero angles; rows orthonormal for a general triple
linked-list insert (sub_545930): append order, counter increment, empty-list and a3-sublist cases
sub_587C20: substring match including empty needle and the two-byte jump-tail path
sub_589901: uppercase path mutates in place; lookup path with dword_8D3F38 set returns decoded buffer
